title: 第4章修炼和医术传承第5章一鳞半爪
slug: 寒门医女别人练武我修仙
content_zh:
“呕~”
花长曦还没来得及为自己得了机缘感到高兴，就被身上如同盛夏里放了几天几夜的厨余垃圾味道刺激得干呕连连。
这时，姚氏推门进来了。
花长曦看到自家阿娘，连忙求救：“阿娘，快叫六哥给我打水，我要沐浴。”
姚氏本能的拒绝：“沐什么浴，你身上有伤口，不能......”
后面的话，姚氏说不出来了，因为她靠近了花长曦，闻到了她身上那刺鼻的味道，直接屏住了呼吸。
同时，也看到了花长曦身上附着着的污垢。
“九娘，你这是怎么了？”
姚氏担心女儿出了什么问题，快速转身出了房间，着急忙慌的将在家休息的花明赫拉了过来，身后还跟着花六郎。
花六郎一进房间，就直接嚷嚷了起来：“九娘你怎么这么臭？”边喊边往屋外退。
花明赫上前查探了一下花长曦的情况，神色有些诧异，随即转头对着花六郎道：“去给你妹妹打水。”
姚氏有些担心：“可是九娘的伤口.....”
“阿娘，没事，我的伤口已经结痂了。”花长曦已经将包扎伤口的纱布取下来了。
姚氏看着女儿结痂的伤口，神色很是惊讶：“伤势怎么恢复得这么快？”
花明赫想了想道：“应该是医药司的药汤起了效果。”
花长曦被熏得胃里翻江倒海的：“阿爹、阿娘，我先沐浴，其他的我们等会儿再说，行不行？”
这下姚氏也不坚持了，赶紧叫花六郎去前院打热水。
十来分钟后，花长曦泡进了浴桶里，足足换了五次水，身上才没了怪味。
“总算活过来了。”
......

花长曦换好衣服后，打开了房门。
一开门，等在外头的花明赫、姚氏，还有花六郎就走了进来。
花六郎围着花长曦转了两圈：“阿爹，九娘这样子像是......武者的淬体啊。”
花明赫没有反对，只是有些疑惑：“医药司的补血药汤还有淬体的功效？”
闻言，花长曦目光闪了闪。
她觉得她这情况，应该跟医药司药汤无关，而是她刚得的机缘造成的。
不过，花长曦什么都没说。
直觉告诉她，妖道抓了八十一个人献祭得来的机缘，最好还是不要让人知道。
花六郎围着花长曦转圈：“九娘，你现在感觉怎么样？”
花长曦：“我觉得神清气爽，身体都比平时轻快了些。”
“那就是淬体了。”
花六郎羡慕的看着花长曦：“九娘，你运气可真好，你知道吗，武者淬体一次可是要花费上百两银子呢。”
“什么运气好。”姚氏瞪了一眼儿子，“你妹妹这次可是遭了大罪。”
姚氏看着丈夫：“赫郎，九娘真的是淬体了？”
花明赫点了点头：“应该是的。”
姚氏吃惊：“医药司的人这么大方，不但救了人，还顺便给淬体了？”
花明赫：“许药师说了，那真血木是医药司发现的新药材，也许医药司的人都不知道真血木到底有哪些功效。”
content_en:
"Ugh~"
Before Hua Changxi had time to feel happy that she had gotten the chance, she was irritated by the smell of kitchen waste that had been left out for days and nights in midsummer and made her retching again and again.
At this time, Yao opened the door and came in.
When Hua Changxi saw her mother-in-law, she quickly asked for help: "Mom, please ask Brother Six to get me some water. I want to take a bath."
Yao refused instinctively: "Why don't you take a bath? You have wounds on your body, you can't..."
Yao couldn't say the next words because she was close to Hua Changxi and smelled the pungent smell on her body, so she held her breath.
At the same time, he also saw the dirt attached to Hua Changxi's body.
"Jiuniang, what's wrong with you?"
Worried that something was wrong with her daughter, Yao quickly turned around and left the room, hurriedly pulling Hua Minghe over who was resting at home, followed by Hua Liulang.
As soon as Hanarokuro entered the room, he immediately shouted: "Jiuniang, why do you stink so much?" He shouted while retreating out of the room.
Hua Minghe stepped forward to check on Hua Changxi's situation. He looked a little surprised, then turned to Hua Liulang and said, "Go get water for your sister."
Yao was a little worried: "But Jiuniang's wound..."
"Aniang, it's okay, my wound has scabbed over." Hua Changxi had already taken off the gauze that was wrapping the wound.
Yao looked at her daughter's scabbed wound and looked surprised: "How come the injury healed so quickly?"
Hua Minghe thought for a while and said, "It should be the medicinal soup from the Department of Medicine that has taken effect."
Hua Changxi was so sick that her stomach was churning: "Dad, aunt, I'll take a bath first, and we'll talk about the rest later, okay?"
Now Yao didn't insist anymore and quickly asked Huarokuro to go to the front yard to get hot water.
Ten minutes later, Hua Changxi soaked in the tub and changed the water five times before the strange smell disappeared.
"Finally alive."
...
After Hua Changxi changed her clothes, she opened the door.
As soon as the door opened, Hua Minghe, Yao Shi, and Hua Liulang who were waiting outside walked in.
Hua Liulang circled around Hua Changxi twice: "Dad, Jiuniang looks like...the tempered body of a warrior."
Hua Minghe did not object, but was a little confused: "The blood-tonifying medicinal soup from the Department of Medicine also has the effect of body tempering?"
Hearing this, Hua Changxi's eyes flashed.
She felt that her situation had nothing to do with the medicine decoction, but was caused by the opportunity she had just obtained.
However, Hua Changxi said nothing.
Her intuition told her that it was best not to let anyone know about the opportunity that the Demon Dao had captured and sacrificed eighty-one people.
Hua Liulang circled Hua Changxi: "Jiuniang, how do you feel now?"
Hua Changxi: "I feel refreshed and my body is lighter than usual."
"That's body quenching."
Hua Liulang looked at Hua Changxi with envy: "Jiuniang, you are so lucky. Do you know that it costs hundreds of taels of silver for a warrior to temper his body at a time?"
"What good luck?" Yao glared at her son, "Your sister suffered a big disaster this time."
Yao looked at her husband: "Helang, Jiuniang has really been tempered?"
Hua Minghe nodded: "It should be."
Yao was surprised: "The people from the Department of Medicine are so generous. Not only did they save people, they also tempered their bodies by the way?"
Hua Minghe: "Pharmacist Xu said that the True Blood Wood is a new medicinal material discovered by the Department of Medicine. Maybe the people in the Medicine Department don't know what effects the True Blood Wood has."
